messages:
marta: Quick sync — we need a partner hotline + war-room flow for the NovaSI marketplace integration go-live. Current gaps: who does initial triage, where do we create the shared channel, and exact PD escalation path. TL;DR: want a one-pager and an ops playbook we can hand to the partner.
john-c: Agree. Can we standardize on creating a shared channel with prefix `partner-warroom-<partner>` and post the ticket link + stack traces there? keeps things discoverable.
ali: Proposed flow:
1) Partner opens ticket -> page `partners-hotline` (PD)
2) On PD ack, PD creates `#partner-warroom-nova` and invites partner + redwood liasons
3) Triage owner (engineering) posts quick problem statement + impact
4) If SEV declared, escalate to `sevs@redwood` routing and open a Zoom bridge

ryan: Nice. A couple of specifics:
- Oncall should set a clear owner within 15m. Use `@oncall-bot claim` command to lock ownership.
- Escalation matrix: 15m ack -> 30m triage -> 60m SEV decision -> executive notif at 3hrs if not mitigated.

marta: Can we capture commands? e.g.
```
/oncall-bot claim
/oncall-bot create-warroom #partner-warroom-nova --invite @partners-ops @john-c
/oncall-bot escalate se v2 --notify execs
```
These are suggestions; eng-infra can wire them into the bot.

john-c: I'll draft the one-pager. Suggest sections: contact tree, channel naming, PD shortcuts, warroom checklist, handback criteria, postmortem owner.

ali: Warroom checklist (for the one-pager):
- Channel created + pinned ticket link
- Initial impact statement (users, customers, revenue) by triage owner
- Data capture: correlation IDs, sample requests, model variant used
- Short-term mitigation options and who will action
- Decision: SEV or non-SEV
- If SEV -> create Zoom bridge + add SRE + partner SRE + account lead

partners-ops: FYI we should add H/W partner contact info and marketplace POA (provisioning hotpaths). Partners expect a fast-handshake procedure.

ryan: Also add a clear handback: warroom closed when root cause identified and either rollout patch or documented rollback plan accepted. Postmortem assigned within 48h.

oncall-bot: NOTE: automated reminder — If `#partner-warroom-nova` exists and no owner claimed in 20m, this bot will DM oncall channel.

marta: Action items:
- john-c: draft one-pager + share by EOD tomorrow
- ali: draft bot commands and checklist items for eng-infra
- ryan: update escalation timings and exec notify thresholds
- partners-ops: provide partner contact and marketplace playbook snippets

john-c: Aiming to have the doc in `docs/partnerships/hotline-playbook.md` (internal). Will ping here when ready.

ali: Small follow-up — do we want a separate public (partner-facing) version vs internal runbook? I'd say yes: partner-facing focused on who to call and SLAs; internal has routing and debug steps.

marta: Yes, two artefacts. Thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to review before publish. :thumbsup:
